premise.claim: ControllerRevision serialization drift across client-go versions causes EqualRevision byte comparison to return false for semantically identical revisions, triggering spurious rollouts
premise.evidence: Unit test LegacyCreationTimestamp_SemanticallyEqual proves the mechanism

findings.claim: handleRevisions: after SetMatchesRevision returns true (semantic match), the code did NOT reassign expectedRevision = currentRevision, so GetRolesRevisionHash used the freshly-serialized revision. The role hash then disagreed with the persisted RIS labels, re-triggering the exact spurious rollout the PR set out to prevent.
findings.verdict: Fixed in 12915120 — one-line `expectedRevision = currentRevision` added. Polarity confirmed: reverting the fix flips the test to FAIL (returns fresh hash 7f54c9ffd5 instead of persisted 5bf9dcc5d5).
